headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 10, 2026**
article:
The Washington Nationals dominated the Cincinnati Reds 7-1, while the Oakland Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox. The New York Mets cruised past the Pittsburgh Pirates 11-1, and the Philadelphia Phillies edged the Toronto Blue Jays in a thrilling finish. The Los Angeles Angels placed right-handed pitcher Shaun Anderson on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Devin Williams (New York Mets), Caleb Kilian (Philadelphia Phillies), Griffin Jax (Tampa Bay Rays), Cooper Pratt (Milwaukee Brewers), Jack Leiter (Texas Rangers), Ben Williamson (Tampa Bay Rays), and Cole Wilcox (Seattle Mariners). These players will be unavailable for their teams in the near future.

The Kansas City Royals bolstered their lineup with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for a package of players, and the Colorado Rockies traded right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-handed pitcher Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Nationals in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dominated the Cincinnati Reds 7-1, handing them a tough loss. Abimelec Ortiz led the Reds' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Brad Lord pitched 2.2 strong innings for the Reds, striking out 4 batters.

top_news.title: **Athletics Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, with a final score of 4-3. Eli White led the Athletics' offense with a 3-hit performance.

top_news.title: **Mets Cruise Past Pirates 11-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing an 11-1 victory. Sean Manaea led the way for the Mets, pitching 7.0 innings with 11 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 7-6 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Caleb Kilian earning the win. Kyle Schwarber led the Phillies' offense, hitting two home runs and driving in four runs.

top_news.title: **Angels RHP Shaun Anderson Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels right-handed pitcher Shaun Anderson has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster as the team looks to make a push in the second half of the season.
